title: Caloric-method source contract for adapted formula volume

source.title: Национальная программа оптимизации вскармливания детей первого года жизни в Российской Федерации

reviewNotes: The source explicitly says formula volume is calculated on actual body weight by the caloric method at 115 kcal/kg during the first six months.
The source provides maximum daily volumes for age 3 months, 4 months and 'after 5 months'.
The source does not provide one universal ml/kg coefficient in this passage; prepared-formula energy density is needed to turn kcal/day into ml/day.
The phrase 'after 5 months' is preserved as source wording and is not silently converted into an inclusive/exclusive numeric boundary.
Children with underweight or overweight are explicitly deferred by the source to separate chapters and must not use this contract without review.
